format: Traditional Restaurant (in-line, no drive-thru), exclusive of real estate costs

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a single FIREHOUSE SUBS® Restaurant, exclusive of real estate costs, ranges from $405,350 to $875,950 for a Traditional Restaurant; ... This includes $26,200 to $26,200 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates.

fee.quote: The standard initial franchise fee for a 10-year Franchise Agreement term is $20,000. The Initial Franchise Fees actually paid for new franchises during our fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 was $20,000 per FIREHOUSE SUBS® Restaurant.
fee.note: Fee prorated for terms of different duration. Background check fee up to $500. Development Agreement: prepaid fee of $20,000 per committed Restaurant. 2026-2028 Development Incentive Program pays a $75,000 cash contribution per Restaurant opened 2026-2028 (plus $25,000 bonus for 2 or more; up to $150,000 under Grow A-Gain or Accelerated Market incentives). Veteran and First Responder DIP pays $100,000 per Restaurant. Market Introduction Fee $5,000 per new Restaurant paid to franchisor.

royalty.quote: Royalty 6% of Gross Sales per Accounting Period. Payable the 3rd day of Accounting Period.

adFund.quote: System Fund Contribution Not to exceed 5% of Gross Sales per Accounting Period (currently 5%).
adFund.note: Currently 5% (maximum 5%). Special Co-Op Contribution: none currently but may be up to 4% of Gross Sales.

otherRecurring.name: Digital Technology Fees
otherRecurring.amount: $150 per Restaurant per month, plus 1% of Digital Sales

otherRecurring.name: Delivery Guest Support Services Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $0.25 to $0.75 per delivery order on the Firehouse Subs® mobile app or website (collected from guests)

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fees
otherRecurring.amount: None currently, but may range from $0 to $1.00 per transaction

transferFee.amount: 50% of our then-current initial franchise fee; $1,500 if transfer is among your owners.

item19.note: Sales are Gross Sales (incl. catering and delivery, excl. refunds and sales tax). Excludes 76 Counter Service Restaurants not open all of 2025 and 21 closed in 2025; company-owned excluded. EBITDA tables based on 704 of 1,137 full-year franchised Restaurants that submitted complete P&Ls (433 excluded); EBITDA is restaurant-level, before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization, franchise fees, loan fees and above-restaurant overhead; 'Other' costs include royalties and System Fund contributions.

special: Development incentive cash contributions ($75,000 to $150,000 per new Restaurant, $100,000 under the Veteran and First Responder program) offset part of the initial investment. Accelerated-market Restaurants get a royalty reduced by 2% of Gross Sales for the first 3 years. Deferred Renovation program can raise royalty to an agreed default rate (typically up to 9%) if renovation is not completed. Development Agreement requires a $1,000 contribution per Restaurant to the Firehouse Subs Public Safety Foundation.
issues: Item 19 says 1,234 franchised Restaurants at December 31, 2025 (U.S., excluding territories) while Item 20 Table 1 shows 1,249 franchised; difference not explained in the cut. Transfer fee is a percentage of the then-current fee (50% of $20,000 would be $10,000, not printed as such).
